subject: Entrust Bio — request for promotional uplift, trial extension, and credits
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for expanded PoC

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the demo was helpful and our ML team is already running a couple of inference tests. We’re having one internal ask from product: if we can extend the PoC window by two weeks and add an extra $8k of platform credits, we can include an additional dataset and finish the evaluation.

Short summary of why:
- We discovered an edge-case workload (long-form clinical notes) that needs one more pass.
- Our compliance team needs an extra week for the security checklist to sign off on the VPC config.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) extend trial end date from 11/30 -> 12/14;
2) provide a one-time $8,000 credit to cover extra token consumption during the extension; and
3) keep current demo pricing (no changes)?

I’ve attached a CSV with the PoC usage so far. Procurement is standing by — they said they can route a quick MOU if we agree.

Appreciate the help,
Jenna
Jenna Park
Director, Product
Entrust Bio

Hi Jenna — thanks for the note and the usage CSV (helpful).

Quick update: the request is reasonable from a product fit perspective. I want to route an internal exception for the combined credit + extension (this is slightly above my playbook). Looping in Marissa to approve a one-time promotional uplift and to confirm contract language for the brief extension.

Operationally:
- We can hold the demo pricing for the extension period (no changes).
- The $8k credit would be promotional (applied to hosted usage) and would not affect future baseline pricing.
- We’ll need an MOU or short-order form agreeing to the revised trial end date and credit usage; procurement@entrustbio can send that.

Marissa — can you confirm whether $8k + 2-week extension needs exec sign-off or if we can greenlight from team? I captured the usage and impact below.

Estimated impact to Redwood: ~$5k marginal cost (hosted tokens + infra) but increases likelihood of conversion by final evaluation.

Thanks,
Lukas

Lukas — forwarding to Priyom for exec review. This is a high-probability mid-market deal; $8k credit for a short extension is within our playbook if we attach a 3-month conversion check or a nominal committed budget thereafter.

Suggested terms for exec clearance:
- One-time promotional credit: $8,000 applied to hosted usage; expires 12/31/2026 if unused.
- Trial extended to 2026-12-14.
- MOU to include a conversion clause: if Entrust converts to a paid plan within 90 days after extension, Redwood will apply a $3,000 onboarding credit against their first invoice.
- No further discounts to list pricing without renewed exec review.

Rationale: small short-term revenue hit but increases conversion odds and gets procurement moving. If Priyom signs off I’ll draft the short MOU (MOU_draft_v2.pdf) and loop legal.

Marissa

Thanks for the summary — reviewed. Approve the one-time $8k promotional credit and a 2-week trial extension with the following conditions:

1) MOU signed that documents the extension dates and credit application (legal review).
2) Entrust provides a short evaluation checklist (3 bullet points) confirming the clinical-notes workload test completion by 12/14.
3) If Entrust does not convert within 90 days post-extension, we close the promotional credit and do not commit to future concessions.
